parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Domain scope. Use `public`, `private`, or a specific private domain name assigned to the team.

parameters.name: inbox
parameters.description: Inbox identifier. Provide a mailbox name or the team SMS phone number (for SMS retrieval). Use `*` to match inbox prefixes where supported by the endpoint.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of messages to skip from the start of the result set.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of messages to return (1-99 unless `full=true`).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor token to continue a prior paged request.

parameters.name: full
parameters.description: When true, returns the full message entity instead of the summary. The Mailinator API enforces a limit of 1 when `full=true`.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Optional long-polling interval. The API waits up to the provided duration (e.g., `1s`, `2m`) for new messages before returning.

parameters.name: delete
parameters.description: Minimum delay before the fetched message is scheduled for deletion (e.g., `1s`, `5m`, `1h`).
